description.narrative: The project will promote access to growth capital for Fund investees in a number of Sub-Saharan African countries. By providing investees with needed financing it will support them to respond to the large gap in the availability of appropriate quality health services and products in these countries. Many of the investees would otherwise face challenges accessing finance. By providing financing to these companies the project will thus expand access to healthcare services and products. Providing support to these companies can be expected to have broader impacts on the markets they operate in and so strengthen these markets competitiveness and resilience.

The proposed project consists in the establishment of the Transform Health Fund (THF or the Fund), a high impact healthcare focused debt fund. THF will seek to provide growth financing to and scale innovative care delivery models and supply chain businesses in the healthcare sector in Africa to achieve public health goals and improve resilience of the health infrastructure in the continent
